units.source_text: 如果不是母亲及时阻止，我肯定还要挨他两三下打吧。

en.t: If Mother had not stopped him in time, I would surely have been hit by him two or three more times.

units.source_text: 母亲从枕头上半抬起头，半骂道：“阿鹤没什么错，为什么要这么对待她？”

en.t: Mother half raised her head from the pillow and said, half scolding, "What has Otsuru done wrong? Why treat her like this?"
